text: Mujhe thoda water chahiye, please.
english: I need some water, please.

text: Aaj lunch mein kya bana hai?
english: What has been made for lunch today?

text: Tumhara phone silent pe hai kya?
english: Is your phone on silent?

text: Please gate lock kar dena.
english: Please lock the gate.

text: Yeh bag bahut heavy hai, help karo.
english: This bag is very heavy, help me.

text: Hum log evening mein market jayenge.
english: We will go to the market in the evening.

text: Bhai, ek plate momos pack kar do.
english: Brother, pack one plate of momos.

text: Mera internet connection bahut slow chal raha hai.
english: My internet connection is running very slow.

text: Aaj traffic bahut zyada hai road pe.
english: There is too much traffic on the road today.

text: Yeh shirt mujhpe achhi lag rahi hai na?
english: This shirt looks good on me, doesn't it?

text: Papa office se kab tak aayenge?
english: By when will Dad return from the office?

text: Kal humara maths ka test hai.
english: Tomorrow we have a maths test.

text: Mujhe cold drink nahi peeni hai.
english: I don't want to drink a cold drink.

text: Yeh movie bahut boring thi yaar.
english: This movie was very boring, buddy.

text: Chai mein sugar thodi kam rakhna.
english: Keep the sugar a little less in the tea.

text: Main kal library jaunga books return karne.
english: I will go to the library tomorrow to return books.

text: Door bell baj rahi hai, dekho kaun hai.
english: The doorbell is ringing, see who it is.

text: Tumhari flight kitne baje land karegi?
english: At what time will your flight land?

text: Aaj weather bahut pleasant hai.
english: The weather is very pleasant today.

text: Please thoda side hona, mujhe nikalna hai.
english: Please move aside a bit, I need to get through.

text: Auto wale bhaiya ne extra paise charge kiye.
english: The auto-rickshaw driver charged extra money.

text: Bhai, GPay pe QR code scan nahi ho raha.
english: Bro, the QR code isn't scanning on GPay.

text: Mujhe laga tumne ticket already cancel kar di hogi.
english: I thought you would have already cancelled the ticket.

text: Mummy ko bol dena ki main dinner bahar karunga.
english: Tell Mom that I will have dinner outside.

text: Hum Goa trip ka plan next month ke liye postpone kar rahe hain.
english: We are postponing the Goa trip plan to next month.

text: Aap paneer tikka medium spicy rakhna, zyada mirchi mat dalna.
english: Keep the paneer tikka medium spicy, don't put too much chili.

text: Metro card recharge karwana hai, counter pe bheed dekho!
english: I need to get my metro card recharged, look at the crowd at the counter!

text: Exam ke baad sab friends milke movie dekhne jayenge.
english: After the exam, all friends will get together and go watch a movie.

text: Ye parcel return karna hai kyunki size fit nahi aa raha.
english: I need to return this parcel because the size doesn't fit.

text: Papa ne kaha hai pehle marks dikhao, phir new phone milega.
english: Dad said show your marks first, then you'll get a new phone.

text: Tumhari battery 5 percent pe hai, power bank use kar lo.
english: Your battery is at 5 percent, use the power bank.

text: Didi ki shaadi ki shopping ke liye hum Sarojini Nagar ja rahe hain.
english: We are going to Sarojini Nagar for my older sister's wedding shopping.

text: Sir, please attendance mark kar dijiye, main bus mein phans gaya tha.
english: Sir, please mark my attendance, I got stuck in the bus.

text: Aaj gym skip kar dete hain, kal se pakka regular jayenge.
english: Let's skip the gym today, from tomorrow we'll definitely go regularly.

text: Ye PDF WhatsApp group pe forward kar do sabko.
english: Forward this PDF to everyone on the WhatsApp group.

text: Mujhe samajh nahi aa raha ki physics ka ye numerical kaise solve hoga.
english: I don't understand how this physics numerical problem will be solved.

text: Bhai, thoda dhaniya aur hari mirch free mein daal dena.
english: Brother, put in a little coriander and green chili for free.

text: Weekend pe koi achhi series suggest karo binge-watch karne ke liye.
english: Suggest a good series to binge-watch on the weekend.

text: Aunty ne pucha ki tumhare board exams kab khatam ho rahe hain.
english: Aunty asked when your board exams are ending.

text: Main payment UPI se karunga, cash change nahi hai mere paas.
english: I will make the payment via UPI, I don't have cash change with me.

text: Usne last moment pe ditch kar diya, ab poora plan chopat ho gaya!
english: They bailed at the last moment, now the whole plan is ruined!

text: Yaar, ye banda hamesha hawa mein baatein karta hai, serious mat lo.
english: Dude, this guy always talks big without substance, don't take him seriously.

text: Chalo chhodo yaar, jo hua so hua, ab chill maaro aur biryani order karo.
english: Leave it buddy, whatever happened has happened, now chill out and order biryani.

text: Mere dimaag ka dahi mat kar, pehle hi boss ne bahut dimaag kharab kar rakha hai.
english: Don't fry my brain, my boss has already messed with my head enough.

text: Bhaiya, ye wala toh bahut mehnga lag raha hai, kuch toh discount laga do!
english: Brother, this one seems very expensive, give at least some discount!

text: Aaj toh subah se bhaag-daud lagi hui hai, ek cup kadak chai mil jaye toh maza aa jaye.
english: It's been non-stop running around since morning today, if I get one cup of strong tea it'll be amazing.

text: Us bande ka attitude toh dekho, jaise khud ko CEO samajhta ho!
english: Look at that guy's attitude, as if he thinks himself to be the CEO!

text: Papa ne pocket money cut kar di kyunki pichle mahine bahut kharcha ho gaya tha.
english: Dad cut my pocket money because too much got spent last month.

text: Chal bye, baad mein baat karte hain, mummy bula rahi hain khana khane ke liye.
english: Alright bye, we'll talk later, Mom is calling me to eat food.
